notes: Bay Area Reporter, 1 January 2004 to 28 July 2005, 83 weekly issues, the last in the Internet Archive collection, read from its DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: Nothing: these are the last issues in the collection, which ends on 28 July 2005. All 1,514 issues are read.
coverage.note: 83 issues; 10,075 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 783 windows after the advertisement filter (350 of them rescued for an event word) in 712 address clusters, of which 286 hold an event word; the tighter filter left 76, all read; plus 592 event-word passages, of which the 15 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 32 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 27 resolved and published, on 26 pages, none seeded; 1 of them placed by hand (the Harvey Milk branch library, named without its address, on the library's place page). 2 held as single facts on parcels with no page (850 Broderick and 439 Powell). 3 unresolved at numbers EAS does not join to a parcel: 1772 Market, 103 Hayes and 4599 18th Street. The audit flags 3 of 32, each a number the cited story does not print: the library's, Trader Joe's site in the item of 3 February 2005 (2112 15th Street, from the report of 3 June 2004) and the Pendulum's (4146 18th Street, from the column of 17 February 2005); each placement note says so.
